answer:254f6f91-f4e5-4088-8ad7-0cbb3e630: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
answer:ebbca259-6a18-4d53-aab9-ed4e047e2: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:8de4ba5b-7b9b-4ed4-a0e9-f1125ae0c: We test our disaster recovery plan annually. The last test was in March 2026 and met the recovery time objective of four hours.
policy:85a173a6-35e7-4bdc-b674-f8890a239: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:863f6c3f-6aec-454e-a92f-9d9068765: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
